        resource = min(resources, key=lambda r: abs(r[0]-x) + abs(r[1]-y))
        dx = clamp(resource[0] - x, -1, 1)
        dy = clamp(resource[1] - y, -1, 1)
        return [dx, dy]

        if dist <= 2:
            # Evasion: move away from enemy
            dx = clamp(x - closest_enemy[0], -1, 1)
            dy = clamp(y - closest_enemy[1], -1, 1)
        else:
            # Pursuing: move towards enemy
            dx = clamp(closest_enemy[0] - x, -1, 1)
            dy = clamp(closest_enemy[1] - y, -1, 1)
        return [dx, dy]

        # Move towards the closest unclaimed or neutral territory cell

            dx = clamp(closest_cell[0] - x, -1, 1)
            dy = clamp(closest_cell[1] - y, -1, 1)
            return [dx, dy]
    
    # Default move: stay or move randomly but towards the center to maintain robustness
    center_x, center_y = max_x // 2, max_y // 2
    dx = clamp(center_x - x, -1, 1)
    dy = clamp(center_y - y, -1, 1)
